prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE polished wide landscape 3:2 game WORLD MAP concept image. Input image is ONLY a style reference: retain its charming Western/European cartoon mobile-game 3D look, rounded chunky shapes, teal/orange salvaged machinery, warm lighting, toy-like proportion, clean readable materials. Zoom OUT much farther than reference: 45-degree isometric strategy map, no horizon, about 6-8 city footprints visible, map legibility and generous clear terrain between points. Post-apocalyptic dry grassland with reclaimed greenery, damaged roads, scattered ruins and small non-gory green zombie groups. This is an original design study, not an actual game screenshot. Show ONE coherent scene, no inset panels, no collage, no HUD, NO TEXT OR LETTERS OR NUMBERS. Friendly teal flags identify player homes and marching units; NPC target is larger and infected green with ragged red banners. Crucially static player homes remain visibly in place while a separate small expedition army moves. Tiny heroes on moving vehicles may shoot one small group of zombies with readable muzzle flashes, but this is a strategic map, not a close-up battle. Consistent shadows and object scale. DIRECTION A: RAILWAY SURVIVOR CAMPS. Main player HOME at lower-left is a FIXED COMPACT SQUARE CAMP, container wall perimeter, central orange energy chimney, two permanent cottages, water tank and small side train platform with ONE parked short teal train. Buildings dominate the camp, train is a minor accessory. Two smaller similarly shaped allied camps occupy upper-left/mid-left. Small wheeled support jeeps approach main camp from allies; a distinct three-vehicle armed road convoy leaves camp gate and follows a short luminous cyan dashed route toward upper-right NPC CITY. NPC target: large permanent abandoned industrial rail town, roughly 3x home area, walls, cooling tower, warehouses, derelict main station, green infection accents. One old railway passes along the edge of terrain and serves platforms; active convoy has TIRES on road, never a rail train on bare ground. Emphasize standard SLG map reading: fixed settlements + independent small moving units.
